page.notes: Catchword "parlamenti" and signature "Ff 2" read at the foot. Running head given without the page number. The first word of the page ("tincatur") is a fragment; the first letter is uncertain and marked [?]. "Britannodimensis" is a proper name read from a small, worn print and is uncertain. "ferenis." is an abbreviation read with some doubt. Long s has been normalised to s throughout; "effe" and "inuritur" are kept as printed. Italic passages are marked from the scan.
